summary.text: Heather Rhyne is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 97 since August 19, 2024, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as pharmacist.

paragraphs.text: Rhyne was born in Cherryville, North Carolina, and received a pharmacy degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 1998.
Ballotpedia lists a prior office of Lincoln County Schools, at-large.
According to Ballotpedia, the Lincoln County GOP Executive Committee appointed her to the House on July 22, 2024, to replace Jason Saine, a fellow Republican.
